I need my AI agents to understand that they should not use the memory system specific to their harnesses unless I explicitly grant them authorization to do so. I switch between agents so frequently that doing that would be counterproductive, as a memory saved to one provider's harness location is not accessible to another coding agent. In general I work in git repos knowledge gardens, and those preferences should be stored in such a way that is provider neutral inside that repo or knowledge garden. To that end, create My/AI/Rule to capture this, as that namespace is read upon agent load. If agents want to, they can ask me where a memory should be recorded.
